newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Central Bank fails to report reserves.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Central Bank fails to report reserves.

text.p: Argentina's Central Bank Wednesday failed to issue its daily report on foreign reserves for the second consecutive day.

Although on Tuesday it said it was unable to provide the figures due to technical problems at the bank's accounting department, on Wednesday it did not provide an explanation for the lack of information.

The last report was issued on Monday, when the bank reported it had $18.32 billion by September 26, of which $2.66 billion, or 14.28 percent, were in securities. The bank normally releases its reserves data with a 48-hour delay.
